Graduate Student Researchers (GSR)s
GSR Duties and Expectations
UCI Graduate Student Researcher (GSR) responsibilities involve assisting faculty with research projects in their field, including data analysis, literature reviews, programming, lab work, and program development, earning salary, tuition, and fee support in exchange for their work, all under faculty supervision and following university guidelines for time reporting and conduct.
Key Aspects:
In essence, a GSR contributes to faculty research, gains valuable experience, and receives financial support, but must adhere to specific university policies and time commitments.
Supervision: Work directly under a faculty member or authorized Principal Investigator (PI).
Compensation: Receive a salary, tuition remission, and/or fee coverage as part of their appointment.
Appointment: Typically 50% time, requiring 20 hours/week.
Reporting: Must report hours and absences in the UCI Time Reporting System.
Eligibility: Primarily for M.S. and Ph.D. students,
Submit a GSR Request
Select the appropriate GSR submission survey below.
Fill out relevant information and submit.
Math staff team will prepare proper documentation for you to sign.
Contract will be emailed to the student and the PI via DocuSign – please sign ASAP.
After the contract is signed, the student’s appointment will be entered into UC Path and appointed subject to PI’s SoPS analyst’s approval.
